description: Calculate the d-band center of the Fe(110) surface from projected density of states.
user_prompt: Calculate the d-band center of the Fe(110) surface (BCC, Im-3m). Extract the d-band center (in eV relative to the Fermi level) from the surface Fe atoms' d-orbital projected DOS and report the final value.

references: Bhattacharjee, Waghmare, and Lee, Sci. Rep. 6, 35916 (2016).
method.modeling: Use a ferromagnetic BCC Fe(110) slab and project the DOS on top-layer Fe atoms only.
method.rationale: Bhattacharjee et al. report full first-moment d-band centers for ferromagnetic Fe(110) as epsilon_d_up = -1.86 eV and epsilon_d_down = +0.48 eV relative to E_F. Their reference calculation used a 4-layer, 4x4 Fe(110) slab with a 3x3x1 k-mesh; the key_parameters above give a compact benchmark protocol with comparable k-point density. The target value is the arithmetic mean of the two spin-resolved d-band centers reported by Bhattacharjee et al., (-1.86 + 0.48) / 2 = -0.69 eV. The 0.4 eV absolute tolerance covers spin-averaging convention, slab thickness, magnetic moment convergence, and DOS integration-window differences.
